meaning: The ordinary pickup clocks in the game, one entry per configuration of the speed-coverage matrix (48): `native` is the summary of the selected clock's capture, as pickup-clock-capture.ts writes and compares it (63 untouched baseline periods and three disturbances). `recorded` is the recording that is current: the PR that recorded it in the game, the commit that added it and the frozen engine head its clock was generated and recorded on (null where the run was on an uncommitted tree). `generation` pins the selection the generator makes today, with the sha256 of its clock; `recorded.clock_sha256` is the clock the game ran. Superseded recordings are in pickup-clock-history-controls.json.

recorded.note: recorded in #265 with generationVerdict "no recovery"; #266 set it to "unstable", the generator's verdict for the same clock, in its copy; the summary is otherwise as recorded
